reason: A settings-page panel for viewing, searching, managing, and removing local agent skills across global and registered workspace directories.

summaries.zh: 在设置页集中查看、搜索和管理全局及项目级本地智能体技能目录。
summaries.en: A settings-page panel for viewing, searching, and managing local agent skill directories at global and project scopes.

capabilities: Reads local global and project skill directories
Lists skill descriptions, bodies, and directory contents
Searches skills within the current scope
Removes skills from managed skill directories
Opens skill directories in the system file manager
